definitions.gloss: to put forth, to announce, to launch (a policy/plan)
definitions.explanation: To publicly announce or introduce a new policy, plan, or initiative. Often used for official or organizational announcements.
To shape metal by hammering from the inside to create a raised pattern on the outside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To put forth a new policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The government put forth a new economic policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{出|だ}している。
examples.english: The company is putting forth its environmental policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{銅板|どうばん}→銅板：25000_douban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{出|だ}して⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The craftsman hammers out the copper plate to create a pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{出|だ}して⟦{装飾品|そうしょくひん}→装飾品：15213_soushokuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The technique of hammering out metal to make ornaments has existed since ancient times.
To emboss a pattern on leather.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive).

COMPOUND VERB: Formed from ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to strike) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out). The combination creates the meaning of 'bringing something forth by striking' or metaphorically 'putting something forward publicly.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{出|だ}す (put forth a policy)
・⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{出|だ}す (announce a policy direction)
・⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{出|だ}す (launch countermeasures)
・⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{出|だ}す (show one's stance)

USAGE: Sense 1 is far more common in modern Japanese, frequently appearing in news and business contexts.
